verdict.description: approved only when you would sign off on executing this plan as written.

summary.description: Two to four sentences: overall assessment of the plan.

gaps.description: Every gap that must be closed before execution. Empty when verdict is approved.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. G1, G2. Reuse the same id when re-raising a previous gap.

area.description: Plan section or step the gap belongs to.

description.description: What is missing, wrong, or untestable, with evidence from the repo when available.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete change to the plan that would close the gap.

resolved_previous.description: One entry per gap from the previous round. Empty on the first round.

resolved.description: true when the plan now closes it or the author's disagreement is accepted.
